description_en: Configures the persistent connection settings for back-to-origin requests of a domain name
description_zh: 配置域名回源长连接设置
name: ConfigL7UsKeepalive

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
> The domain name must have a website service forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The persistent connection settings for back-to-origin requests of Anti-DDoS Proxy. The value is a string that represents a JSON struct. The JSON struct contains the following fields:

- **enabled**: Boolean | Required | Specifies whether to enable persistent connections for back-to-origin requests.
- **keepalive_requests**: Integer | Required | The number of requests that can be sent over a persistent connection.
- **keepalive_timeout**: Integer | Required | The idle timeout period of a persistent connection
parameters.help_zh:
高防回源长连接设置参数，使用JSON结构体转化的字符串格式表示，JSON结构体包含以下字段：

- **enabled**：Boolean类型 | 必选 | 回源长连接配置开关。
- **keepalive_requests**：Integer类型 | 必选 | 长连接复用的请求数量。
- **keepalive_timeout**：Integer类型 | 必选 | 长连接的空闲超时时间
parameters.name: upstream_keepalive

parameters.help_en: The idle timeout period of the persistent connection between the client and Anti-DDoS Proxy
parameters.help_zh: 客户端跟高防长连接的空闲超时时间
parameters.name: downstream_keepalive
